output.murderer: Dr Casimir Vauthier, the family physician
output.reasoning: Rosa's kitchen clock runs 15 minutes fast. So the piano began at 22:33 true and stopped at 22:46 true. Madame says the doctor left at 22:28 by the salon clock, which showed 9:55 when the bell struck ten, so it runs 5 minutes slow. That makes his departure 22:33 true, which matches the piano. Madame is honest, so the doctor was out of the salon from 22:33 to 22:46. The doctor claims he left at 10:45 by his own watch. His watch is 2 minutes fast, so that would be 22:43 true, which contradicts the piano. He lied about when he left. Félix's watch is 20 minutes slow (it showed 8:40 at nine). His thump and repeater at 10:18 by that watch is 22:38 true. Girard's watch is 4 minutes slow, from the piano start (10:29 watch, 22:33 true) and the piano stop (10:42 watch, 22:46 true). His bells at 10:34 by that watch are also 22:38 true. Both witnesses put the blow at 22:38, while the piano played and while the doctor was out of the room. The only other claim about that time, that the doctor was away fetching cigars, comes from the doctor himself. Madame was at the piano and Girard was in the street. Félix was in the library, and Girard joined him only later. Lina and Rosa were in the kitchen.
